precision: Existing FP16 base engine; not an adoption selection or a comparison to H22
attention: eager; existing private serving engine configuration
tasks: Two new authored evaluation-only synthetic open/enable/save workflows, one English and one Arabic, each three sequential turns; independent persisted-state verifier
restart_tasks: Repeat the same two workflows after destructive fault probes; recovery checks, not additional independent quality samples
allocator_scope: Actual PyTorch process allocator cap followed by bounded8MiB allocation and restoration; not whole-device physical OOM
cancel_criterion: Exact transport Event.set receipt; real-model CUDA matrix event recorded after enqueue before receipt, still pending at later private child acknowledgment; fault code cancelled, owned child successfully reaped and no contradictory generation-return evidence. Otherwise active-CUDA cancellation remains unqualified

source_gates.graft: Genuine graph/impact, deep context false, not correctness proof

runtime_environment: Same genuine free Kaggle T4 VM after the six H22 profiles and verified exports; recheck physical UUID, exact pins/font/RAQM and fully clean source before loading
cache_preparation: After H22 finishes, move only the owned pinned remote H22 cache into a new nonexistent approved H23 path; no local base weights or adapter changes
execution: One reviewed source invocation with --faults and a new output directory; external official coreutils timeout enforces1200seconds plus5second kill grace over its owned child process group. Preserve incremental tasks/fault/reap/reload evidence and command stdout/stderr on success or failure; timeout is incomplete execution, never success; export immediately
logging_limits: Owned model worker stderr is DEVNULL in reviewed source; raw command stdout/stderr and structured worker wire/fault traces are retained, not full worker stderr. Independent reviewers must inspect missing/contradictory cancellation evidence and leave qualification false on incomplete records
forbidden: synthetic CUDA delay masquerading as actual model work
